author: _DipperPines
body:
IGN: DipperPines_12

Staff Who Banned Me: Zero

Reason: Fly Hacks/Spider


So, I am going to deny that I was hacking, because I wasn't. I was using a forge mod. And before you ignore this, hear me out. This mod, its called DaFlight, allows you to fly and change fly speeds. I was on my 1.10 server before going on Avicus, building, so I had it on. I did not feel like switching to 1.8 because it takes forever to load. And as most of you know, Avicus has bad block lag in 1.9 and 1.10. So I kept getting block lag and falling into the void. And I forgot to mention, you can ask Nidhiki, Patrikano, or Zero, I was 1v1ing Nidhiki. So twice when I block lagged out for an instant I hovered in mid air by accident because it is easy to spam my keyboard when I get aggravated. And, whenever I flew by accident I instantly stopped and fell into the void. So, at no point did I use this to my advantage.

Thank You For Reading,

-Dipper

replies.author: Protel
replies.body:
After reviewing the evidence provided, and your statement saying that you used an illegal modification leads me to deny this appeal.

* To add to your recent reply, you still remained and played on the server with an illegal modification which is completely against the rules and is a permanent ban until a reasonable appeal date. And did in fact use it to evade death on multiple occasions.

Please appeal in approximately 5-8 months.

- John
